def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])

        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

import os,re,collections,itertools
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
inp=G['Demo pair 1 input']; out=G['Demo pair 1 output']
H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
# Build candidate fills using good shifts; check whether a single consistent value exists for every zero cell across all consistent shifts.

conflict=False
for (i,j) in zeros:
    vals={sh for sh in [-8,-1,6,13,20,27]}
    okvals=set()
    for sh in sorted(vals):
        q=(j-sh)  # no wrap
        ii=i-1
        if 0<=q<W and inp[ii][q] or False: pass
        q=(j-sh)%W
        vv=out[i-1][q]
        okvals.add(vv)
    print(i,j,'cand',sorted(okvals))
